Addresses item 3 of #1569: removes `// @ts-nocheck` from `src/utils/internal/iron-crypto.ts`.

With the check enabled there were 6 errors, all `Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>` not assignable to `BufferSource` in the `crypto.subtle` calls. The fix is type-only: the internal byte buffers are annotated as `Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>`:

- `Password`, `GenerateKeyOptions.iv` and `Key.iv`
- `decrypt` / `getEncryptParams` data
- `randomBits` / `randomBytes` return types
- `base64Decode` return type in `internal/encoding.ts` (it always returns a fresh `new Uint8Array(...)`, so the narrower type is accurate; `iron-crypto` is its only caller)

No casts and no runtime changes. Session passwords are typed as `string` in `SessionConfig`, so nothing public changes.

## Testing

- `tsc --noEmit` is clean with the `@ts-nocheck` removed.
- `oxlint` and `oxfmt --check` pass.
- `vitest --run`: session tests pass. 3 tests fail locally (`canonicalPathname`, `/x%5Ey guards /x^y`, `getRequestFingerprint ... (node)`) and fail the same way on `main`, because I ran Node 22 while the repo requires Node 24.

Prepared with AI assistance (Claude Code).
